# ffxf_image (Data Source)

Looks up an FFXF Cloud operating system or application image by slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ffxf_image" "debian" {
  slug = "debian-13"
}

resource "ffxf_instance" "web" {
  hostname = "web-01"
  plan     = "nano"
  region   = "montreal"
  image    = data.ffxf_image.debian.slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Stable image slug, such as debian-13.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Display name of the image.
- `family` (String) Operating system or application family.
- `category` (String) Image category: linux, windows, bsd, app, or other.
- `version` (String) Image version, when applicable.
- `status` (String) Availability status of the image.
- `regions` (List of String) Region slugs where the image is offered.
- `min_disk_gb` (Number) Minimum compatible disk size in GiB, when specified.
- `min_memory_mb` (Number) Minimum compatible memory in MiB, when specified.
- `default_user` (String) Default account name on the image.
- `supports_ssh_keys` (Boolean) Whether SSH key provisioning is supported.
